# Enable the 49 Workbench tile pairs and six more full-example covers in one publication pass

## Context

The [Portal theme switch](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21940) introduces the first six published-pair markers. Two more asset batches have now had their independent look. Keeping the rest of the verified flags in one data change avoids a new CI pipeline per picture.

## The Problem

The 49 accepted Workbench pairs have different capture IDs and catalog IDs. The six remaining full-example pairs have their own records. The Portal should request a light sibling only when the corresponding dark and light files have been published.

## The Architectural Reality

[`Example` and the shared List](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21940) consume `hasLightCover`. The two Pages sources of truth are [the 49 tiles](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/174) and [the six full examples](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/175). Match catalog records by exact base asset path, including the `tiles/` directory. The broad fallback inventory stays on #21942. The wave of entirely new records is #21934.

## The Fix

Set the availability flag on the matching 55 existing records in a single publication pass. Preserve the six markers from the render PR. Keep the two contrast defects and the seven 960 px planning-layout cases out of this pass. Update the search-tile regression to exercise a real paired tile while retaining coverage of single-file data.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] The data delta enables exactly the 49 tile and six full-example pairs accepted for these PRs. Their files and names match the Pages trees. Before merge, verify the assets are available on Pages main.
- [ ] Confirm an already-mounted tile, a tile in search, and a full-example cover all follow the actual Portal theme. A card with one asset makes no speculative light request. Selection and scroll remain stable.
- [ ] Record the union with the initial six entries and preserve the unresolved records on #21942. Local capture, design approval, merge and deployed Portal proof are recorded separately.

## Out of Scope

New per-record capture metadata, a catalog architecture change, and claiming the 143-record baseline fully paired.

## Related

Parent #21942; consumer #21936; producer #21933; #21939 for the seven rejected planning layouts. Live latest-open + closed sweep: searched paired/backfill/cover and catalog activation; #21942 is the whole remaining set, #21936 builds the renderer, #21934 is the separate new-record pass. Clio confirmed this specific grouped handoff.
